readings: Match manager awards to players on `player_id`, dropping unmatched awards, and group by the player's throwing hand (`throws`), with a missing value as its own group. In each group, count the award rows, so a manager who won three awards adds 3. Turn each count into a share of the total of the counts across all groups. Keep only the hands whose share is above the average share across hands. Return one row with the total of their counts, their average share, and the average amount by which their share exceeds that average share. No rounding.
queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT p.throws AS throws, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM manager_award ma
  JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.throws
),
s AS (
  SELECT throws, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share
  FROM g
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s
)
SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_count,
       AVG(s.share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess
FROM s, a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;
